Limit: %1$s characters, %2$s nesting levels. S1 does not validate against the tool schema.
Arguments exceed %1$s characters; edit or shorten them.
Closing requests cancellation but does not release an occupied worker slot. The manager continues tracking actual exit. Uncooperative full-trust code may require a process restart.
WARNING: no data snapshot or data rollback, including preferences and secrets. Old code will receive the newer data and may be incompatible.
I reviewed this exact digest and every full destination; author identity is unverified.

Only a host-owned read-only content page is enabled. No provider engine, MCP connection/auth, Skill execution, persona application or language override. Updates replace the page snapshot, not an agent run. Existing disabled state is preserved.
Data recovery mode: importing is unavailable until a resumed cold start.
Uninstall retains data ID ownership; cross-type reuse is unavailable.
Untrusted plain text / JSON. No links, execution, authentication or network requests.
Data recovery mode: import and enabling are unavailable in this process. Resume only applies at the next cold start.
Declarations are metadata, not a permission sandbox or approval.
SHA-256 checks byte consistency, not author identity or update trust
Entry state describes the listener only. No agent/chat backend is connected; opening a session remains unavailable.
Entry lifetime attempt limit reached; additional listeners were not started. Restart required.
Actual execution exited; worker capacity has been released.
Actual execution has NOT exited. A terminal result, timeout or cancellation is not proof of exit; capacity may remain occupied.
Confirming requests framework scope and publishes this exact payload. First signer is pinned; a different signer is rejected.

If Theta cannot open: disable Theta or remove target scope in the framework manager, then force-stop target. Last resort: disable the framework in root manager or uninstall Theta with adb. Startup quarantine is target/version-local; clearing target data resets it.
S1 Modern Hook — dedicated ordinary target only
Full-trust code runs inside the target. Live disable depends on framework preference delivery; restart the target to exit Hook code. No custom target-to-Theta callback endpoint.
APK and data ZIP are separate routes. Failed APK verification never falls back to data.
%1$s\nFirst install enables the plugin. Updates preserve enabled state and take effect after restarting the app.
Integrity verified; author identity not authenticated.
Invalid JSON arguments. Check object syntax, size and nesting limits.
Restarting or reopening this screen does not reset it.
24-hour observation starts only after this version first starts successfully.
The 24-hour observation starts at the updated version\'s first successful start, not installation or reopening this dialog.
Operation failed. See diagnostic logs for technical details.
Cannot save plugin-page recovery journal; page execution blocked.
Request scope and publish reviewed APK
Recovery requested. To skip all plugins, launch recovery after force-stopping the app.
Could not save recovery request; plugins remain suppressed.
Delete this rejected package, all its data and its signer binding. This does not trust or run the package.
Result text display truncated to 4096 characters.
Resume saved for next cold start

CODE-ONLY rollback: after a cold restart the previous code returns, but current data, preferences and secrets remain unchanged. There is NO data rollback; the old code may be incompatible with newer data.
Normal rollback restores this plugin\'s private data directory, including preferences and secrets. Changes outside it are not restored.
Code-only rollback: NO data, preferences or secrets rollback.
Rollback includes plugin private data, preferences and secrets.
Rollback availability is decided by the manager, not a UI countdown.

Normal rollback: after a cold restart the previous code and its pre-update private data, preferences and secrets return. Changes saved in that directory since the snapshot are lost. Changes outside it are not restored.
Rollback details are unavailable; this confirmation cannot proceed.
Safe mode: code and data suppressed for this process.
Safe mode: code suppressed for this process.
This signer set is pinned until an explicit clear-data uninstall. Plugins execute with the host\'s full privileges.
Open target settings — force-stop, then relaunch
Direct full-trust plugin call, not an agent run. Approval requests are denied; input requests return unavailable. Cancellation does not undo effects.
Tool name and spec are read only by the admitted worker after invocation.
Tool registration is no longer available for a new call.
Revoke its host page and delete archives. ID ownership is retained, including after restart; code reuse and explicit release are not offered. No plugin private data was initialized.
Host extensions are removed immediately. Loaded code and files may remain until the app restarts.
Crash suspect; disabled until explicitly enabled
Safe mode; loading skipped until restart
Crash quarantine acknowledgement failed; loading blocked until restart
Disabled; restart required before loading again
Enabled for next start; restart required
Update failed; rollback on next start
Managed scope failed; disabled in process; persistence failed; restart required
Managed scope failed; disabled; cleanup failed; restart required
Managed scope failed; disabled; restart required
Safe mode; data activation skipped until restart
Crash quarantined; explicitly enable to validate and resume
Framework unavailable; open LSPosed and enable the module
Multiple framework services; restart with one framework
Framework disconnected; target restart required, switch propagation unknown
Hook operation cancelled before completion. No new completion was confirmed.
Global switch saved; live propagation unverified. Force-stop target for guaranteed code exit.
Published %1$s; cold-restart target. Target execution not yet verified.
Remote cleanup incomplete; next publication blocked until cleanup succeeds.
%1$d plugin diagnostic failures. See diagnostic logs for technical details.
Entry diagnostic details are available in diagnostic logs.
Invocation diagnostic details are available in diagnostic logs.
Import cleanup is pending. Use Retry import cleanup, then import again.
Package changed while installing (digest mismatch). Select the file again and review its digest before retrying.
Package signer does not match the trusted signer. Select an update signed by the original signer.
APK signature verification failed. Select an intact, correctly signed APK.
Signer binding is missing. Use clear-data uninstall before installing again; this deletes retained plugin data.
This version is already installed or older. Select a higher version to update.
An update or rollback is pending. Restart the app before retrying.
The plugin API level is unsupported. Select a plugin compatible with this host.
The import confirmation is no longer valid. Select the file again and confirm the new import.
The data page is no longer active. Return to the plugin list and check its state before reopening.
Cannot read the selected file. Select an accessible file using the system document picker.
The plugin or tool is no longer active. Return to the plugin list and enable it before retrying.
The tool is quarantined after repeated failures. Restart the app before retrying.
Tool execution capacity is unavailable. Wait for active calls to exit before retrying.
Set up a model before sending a message.
Saved credentials cannot be read. Please enter them again.
Could not save or read model settings. Check the endpoint, model and API key.
The operation could not finish. Your stored history is retained. Restart the app if storage is unavailable.
Task paused. Review tool states before continuing.
The model request failed. Check the chat model and endpoint settings; this chat requires tool-call support. Review the previous outcome before retrying.
Saved tool step resolved. Send a new message to continue; nothing was replayed automatically.
Start a conversation. Configure your model to send the first message.
This tool needs your approval. Choose whether to allow this call once, for this conversation, always, or reject it.
Earlier effects are unknown. Check what happened before approving more work.
The previous process ended. Confirm only what you have checked; this does not undo effects or repeat the tool.
OpenAI-compatible Chat endpoint. Saving replaces the active configuration for future runs. The API key is encrypted on this device.

Refused, filtered, interrupted, empty and discarded truncated attempts remain available here. Discarded content is never sent in later model requests. Older truncated records may also have a committed history entry.
The response reached its output limit. Partial text is not a completed answer.
The response exceeded the context window. Partial text is not a completed answer.
The request failed or was interrupted. Partial text is not a completed answer.
The request exceeds the available context or memory budget. Enable a bounded summary with a verified model window to continue without deleting history.
The task has reached its cumulative step or retry limit. A restart or continuation does not reset this limit.
The reply was truncated. Review it and explicitly continue the same task.
Repeated tool calls stopped this task. Review the tool results before continuing.
Tool execution or effects still require review. Resolve the visible approvals or recovery decisions and wait for actual worker exit.
A previous request has an uncertain outcome. Check its effects before accepting another attempt.

Optional summaries use the configured model and may incur charges. Original history, tool approvals and cumulative task limits remain intact. Enter its verified context window in tokens; summary admission conservatively charges UTF-8 bytes plus framing and output reserve, not an exact tokenizer.
Retry only after checking the previous request. It may have run remotely; accepting retry can duplicate remote effects. This does not approve local tools or release their resources.
I reviewed the outcome; accept retry
Delete this session and its saved images? This cannot be undone.

Saved separately from chat. Enter an OpenAI-compatible base URL, image model and key. Ask to draw in the normal chat box; no image mode is needed. The chat endpoint must support tool calls. Prompt writing and API questions should stay text-only.
Configure the image model, base URL and key in Model settings, then explicitly request a new image.
This call was already attempted and will not be submitted again. Check the previous result before requesting a new image; it may be charged.
Image generation stopped or failed. Check model settings and service availability. No automatic retry; the service may already have charged this request.
No image generation request was sent.
Saved image is missing or invalid. No new generation request was sent.
This conversation still has work or an unknown result to resolve. Review its recovery actions (including older messages) before deleting.
Approval needed. Open Theta to allow or deny the tool.
Task paused. Open Theta to review an uncertain result.
Background service unavailable. Return to Theta and explicitly retry the task.

Allow Theta to run without battery optimization in system settings so tasks can continue when you leave the app or lock the screen. This does not guarantee survival on every device. You can skip this; we will not ask again.
Battery settings are unavailable. You can change battery restrictions later in system App info.
Tasks can still run, but task progress, the notification Stop button and approval reminders may be hidden. Use Stop in the chat. You can enable notifications later in system App info.

State: %1$s
Reason: %2$s
Steps: %3$d · Retries: %4$d
Server execution unknown: %5$s
Only recognized reasons are shown; raw responses and exceptions are omitted.
Yes — review the previous request before retrying.
Not reported (does not prove no remote effects).
Unrecognized or oversized reason omitted for privacy.
History or request exceeds the runtime memory budget.
The model returned an empty response.
Saved context is incompatible with the selected model.
Local tool execution or effects still require reconciliation.
Server continuation is missing or has reached its limit.
Input was accepted but the run has no durable completion yet.
Invalid Unicode in a tool call; no local tools were registered.
Tool execution was interrupted; exception details omitted.
The saved checkpoint requires explicit continuation or review.
Select a model below or enter its name manually. Some providers do not list every supported model.
No models were listed. You can still enter a model name manually.
Check the endpoint and API key, then try again.
The provider rejected the model list request. Check the key and endpoint, or enter a model manually.
The model list request timed out. Try again or enter a model manually.
Could not connect to the provider. Try again or enter a model manually.
The model list is too large. Enter a model name manually.
The provider returned an unsupported model list. Enter a model name manually.
Saved settings could not be read. Nothing was changed. Retry loading or re-enter the settings and key.
Enter the endpoint, model and API key again. The saved record stays unchanged until you save its replacement.
A key is saved for this endpoint. Leave the key empty to keep using it.
The endpoint has changed. Enter a new API key to save or fetch models.
Check the endpoint, model, key and compatibility options. The reasoning field must be a valid, non-reserved identifier.
Enable only for endpoints supporting explicit cache_control. Keep off for standard OpenAI.
Leave empty to disable. Use letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore; reserved message fields are not allowed.
Controls default prompts for attended chat runs. Saved grants break automatically if a tool definition changes.
Read and Write tools run without prompts. Device control and Root tools ask for approval unless covered by an active grant.
Attended Read, Write, Device control, and Root tools run without prompts. Keep enabled only when you trust the active model and prompts.
Only built-in Read tools run automatically; all Write, third-party, MCP, Device control, and Root tools ask unless granted.
Full-auto mode permits attended Device control and Root tools without asking. Prompt injection or model mistakes can act immediately on this device.
I understand the risk and want to enable Full-auto approval.
When enabled, Root approval cards also offer Allow for session and Allow always. Off by default.
Explicit deny rules, unverified unknown side effects, and unattended background tasks never inherit Balanced or Full-auto relaxations.
Full-auto approval is active · Device control and Root tools run without prompts
Session and permanent Root grants are off. Enable multi-call Root grants in Approval mode settings if needed.
Multi-call Root grants are disabled in Approval mode settings.
System Accessibility settings could not be opened on this device.
No Root required · Works without special privileges
Theta\'s own Accessibility service is not enabled (services from other apps do not apply). Open Accessibility settings if a host service is available, then refresh.
Shizuku manager was detected passively, but running service and authorization status cannot be confirmed without prompting. Ensure Shizuku is running before use.
Shizuku manager was not detected. Install and start the Shizuku service before using features that require it.
A su binary was detected passively without requesting Root. Actual Root authorization remains unverified until runtime.
Root or LSPosed is not ready. Grant access in your Root manager or enable Theta in LSPosed Manager if this plugin needs it.
Environment and capability tags are passive advisory guidance only: they do not prompt for permissions, block installation, or sandbox in-process dex code.
Defaults to the model name if left blank. Saving makes this profile active for subsequent runs.
Applies to subsequent runs only; active tasks are never modified mid-run.
Requests are sent without an Authorization header. Disable to enter an API key.
Up to %1$d characters. Prepended as a stable system message for new runs without volatile timestamps.
Enabled by default. Disable for text-only models to block sending images before network requests.
Image input is disabled for the active model profile. Remove attached images or enable image input in provider settings.
Selected image is unsupported, corrupted, or exceeds safety limits (JPEG/PNG/WEBP, max 8 MiB, max 4096 px / 4 MP).
Up to %1$d images can be attached per message.
Unsigned data package · Author identity unverified
Prefilled from %1$s. Saving creates an independent host profile copy that future plugin updates or removal will never redirect.
Preset models (tap to select, or edit / fetch below)
Connect external tools. Each tool uses the normal approval and result ledger. Review the destination before enabling.
Could not load or save MCP settings. Check the address and credentials, then retry. Existing records are preserved.
No MCP connections yet. Add one or import a data package preset.
Refresh failed · calls remain paused; tap Refresh to retry
This preset requires OAuth. This version needs a manually supplied Token; interactive OAuth will be supported later.
Leave blank to keep the saved credential for this unchanged destination.
Enter a credential for this destination. Changing the address requires a new credential.
New connections are saved disabled. Enable after checking the destination.
